verses.1: Pavlos, a slave of Christ Jesus, a called apostle, sent forth for the gospel of God.
verses.2: He who was foretold by his prophets in holy writings.
verses.3: Regarding his son, who was born from David’s semen, through flesh.
verses.4: By the power of the Son of God, who rose from the dead through the Spirit of Holyness, Jesus Christ, our Lord.
verses.5: Therefore, we take this as an opportunity to send out messengers who will spread the message of faith among all nations, in honor of His name.
verses.6: In whom also you who are called by Jesus Christ stand.
verses.7: To all those who are beloved by God, and who are called holy men in Jerusalem. May grace and peace be upon us from our God the Father, and from Jesus Christ.
verses.8: First of all, I thank my God for Jesus Christ on behalf of all of you, because your faith is recognized throughout the world.
verses.9: For I have a witness of God, whom I worship in my spirit during the gospel of His Son. I will never forget you.
verses.10: Always, during my prayers, I hope that I will be able to fulfill God’s desire to come before you.
verses.11: For I long to see you, so that I may give you a spiritual gift to help you in your struggle.
verses.12: This is why it has been mentioned among you because of the shared belief between you and me.
verses.13: I don’t want to ignore you, brothers. I’ve tried to come to you many times before. I even delayed it until the end, just so that I could bring some benefits to you and to the rest of the people in this community.
verses.14: I am a debtor to both Greeks and barbarians; I am a debtor to both wise and foolish people.
verses.15: Thus, I am ready to preach to you who are in Jerusalem.
verses.16: For I do not despise the gospel. For it is a power of God, which brings salvation to all who believe, both Jews and Greeks.
verses.17: For justice of God is revealed in him, from faith to faith, as it is written: “The righteous will live by faith.”
verses.18: For the anger of God from heaven is revealed against all their wickedness and injustice toward humans, as they conceal the truth.
verses.19: For what is known about God is evident to them; for God has revealed Himself to them.
verses.20: For those invisible things that are created by the world itself, we refer to them as “poems”. Their power and strength lie in their ability to be considered as such.
verses.21: For they did not honor or praise the God as a true god. Instead, they were filled with sorrow during their thoughts about this matter. Their hearts became filled with despair.
verses.22: They were wise and kept themselves apart from others.
verses.23: And they diminished the glory of that decaying god, by creating an image of a decaying human being, with rotten teeth, four limbs, and damaged organs.
verses.24: Therefore, the God subjected them to the desires of their hearts, so that they would be led to a state of impurity in their desire to honor their own bodies.
verses.25: They distorted the truth about God in their lies. They treated the builder with disrespect and mistreatment. But the builder is indeed worthy of praise throughout all ages. Amen.
verses.26: Therefore, the God gave them to suffer with honor. For they also transformed their natural functions into those that are inherent in nature itself.
verses.27: Similarly, those who were involved in the production of cheese also stopped using natural methods of producing cheese. They became more selfish and focused only on their own interests. They continued to exploit each other, thereby creating a situation where they could not enjoy the benefits that should have been theirs.
verses.28: And since they did not believe that God existed, God made them subject to unbelief, forcing them to do things that were not right.
verses.29: Having suffered all kinds of injustice, wickedness, deceit, and harm, amidst the slander, murder, lies, and dishonor.
verses.30: Crazy, arrogant, overbearing, conceited, cruel, those who do evil deeds, and those who deceive others.
verses.31: Without harmony, without unity, without order, in a state of unrest.
verses.32: Knowing that it is God’s right, and that those who do such things deserve death, they not only commit these acts, but they also expect others to do the same.
